nodes.label: Ten short notes form one continuous reading sequence. Review them once, then compare the replacement revision.
Start with a single purpose. Keep the opening note specific enough to recognize later.
Name the edges of the work. A short boundary makes the rest of the notes easier to read.
Put the next useful idea after the current one. Readers should be able to follow the sequence.
Keep one concrete detail close to each main point. Separate details that serve different purposes.
Leave a clear pause between groups. A little space helps the reader find the next section.
Read the notes once from top to bottom. Mark the review only after considering the whole sequence.
Keep the current review count when the caller supplies a new revision of these notes.
A replacement can change the title and summary while leaving the same component mounted.
The final sections should remain reachable. Long content must keep its ordinary reading order.
Finish with a clear end note. The revision and review count should agree with the current state.
End note: revision A; review count 0
